title.narrative: Strengthen NDA capacity to enhance Ethiopia's access to climate finance

description.narrative: Active

this Readiness grant proposal will: 1) Strengthen NDA capacity through capacity building training, development of procedures and establishment of platform that will enable NDA to fulfill their roles and responsibilities. 2) Support the accreditation process of a financial institution that will enable Ethiopia to engage potential private sectors. 3) Support the development of high-quality project concept notes that will enable Ethiopia to enhance access to climate finance 4) Improve the capacities of the NDAs, DAEs, and executing entities to scale up best practices for several climate priority sectors.
